tasks.gr12-paper1-human-reproduction-homeostas: Topic: Paper 1 Consolidation — Human Reproduction and Homeostasis. Revise the reproductive systems, menstrual cycle, fertilisation, implantation, pregnancy, the placenta, hormonal control, blood glucose regulation and thermoregulation. Ask Grade 12 learners to answer exam-style application questions that integrate these systems.
tasks.gr12-paper1-response-coordination-plants: Topic: Paper 1 Consolidation — Response Coordination and Plant Responses. Revise the nervous system, reflex arcs, receptors, the eye, the ear, endocrine glands, negative feedback, homeostasis, plant hormones and tropisms. Ask Grade 12 learners to interpret diagrams and explain coordinated responses in humans and plants.
tasks.gr12-paper2-genetics-evolution-consolida: Topic: Paper 2 Consolidation. Revise DNA, protein synthesis, meiosis, genetics, pedigrees, sex linkage, evolution by natural selection and human evolution. Ask Grade 12 learners to answer integrated Paper 2 questions, including genetic crosses, evidence-based evolution items and structured explanatory responses.
